description: This file contains a shell script function 'platform_do_upgrade_dualboot_datachk' that handles the dual-boot upgrade process for embedded Linux devices with U-Boot bootloader. It manages partition detection, image integrity verification, updating environment variables, and flashing new images to device storage.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_dualboot_datachk
methods.description: Handles the process of upgrading firmware with dual-boot support, involving partition management, image verification via MD5, environment variable setup, and flashing images.
